script.title: They Dynamited Jefferson Off Rushmore and Started Over
script.hook_text: This Jefferson is the second one
sentences: The Jefferson on Mount Rushmore is the second one they carved.
Sculptor Gutzon Borglum and 400 workers worked on the South Dakota mountain from 1927 to 1941.
They blasted with dynamite, then drilled closely spaced holes and broke small pieces off by hand.
Jefferson was supposed to sit to the left of George Washington, and work there had already started.
Then the crew found the rock on that side was unsuitable.
So the unfinished Jefferson was dynamited away, and a new one was carved on Washington's right.
Washington got to watch his neighbor get blown up and start over.
script.description:
Thomas Jefferson's first face on Mount Rushmore was blown off the mountain.
The rock was wrong, so they carved him again on the other side.
claims_en: The Thomas Jefferson figure on Mount Rushmore is the second one; the first was dynamited.
Gutzon Borglum and 400 workers sculpted the carvings between 1927 and 1941.
Mount Rushmore is in South Dakota.
The carving used dynamite, then honeycombing: drilling closely spaced holes so small pieces of rock could be removed by hand.
Jefferson was originally intended to appear to the left of Washington, and work there was begun.
The rock there was found to be unsuitable.
The work on Jefferson's figure was dynamited and a new figure was sculpted to the right of Washington.
